dragging.description: Whether the splitter is currently being resized.

getSizes.description: Returns the current sizes of the panels.

setSizes.description: Sets the sizes of the panels.

getItems.description: Returns the items of the splitter.

getPanels.description: Returns the panels of the splitter.

getPanelById.description: Returns the panel with the specified id.

getPanelSize.description: Returns the size of the specified panel.

isPanelCollapsed.description: Returns whether the specified panel is collapsed.

isPanelExpanded.description: Returns whether the specified panel is expanded.

getLayout.description: Returns the layout of the splitter.

resetSizes.description: Resets the splitter to its initial state.

getResizeTriggerState.description: Returns the state of the resize trigger.

orientation.description: The orientation of the splitter. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`

size.description: The controlled size data of the panels

defaultSize.description:
The initial size of the panels when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the size of the panels.

panels.description: The size constraints of the panels.

onResize.description: Function called when the splitter is resized.

onResizeStart.description: Function called when the splitter resize starts.

onResizeEnd.description: Function called when the splitter resize ends.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the splitter. Useful for composition.

keyboardResizeBy.description: The number of pixels to resize the panel by when the keyboard is used.

nonce.description: The nonce for the injected splitter cursor stylesheet.

onCollapse.description: Function called when a panel is collapsed.

onExpand.description: Function called when a panel is expanded.

registry.description:
The splitter registry to use for multi-drag support.
When provided, enables dragging at the intersection of multiple splitters.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

Panel.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

ResizeTrigger.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state
